text: Swift-4 is implemented in Swift; the language was chosen for its tooling.
Plan around the retirement date of Dunlin-2: June 26, 2028 is when it goes dark.

The yearly budget for Shrike-5 is $3400k, covering licences and hosting.
Questions about Egret-4 start with its owner, the Sprocket team; they triage anything filed against it. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
